headline: Yum! Brands Q2 Earnings Call Highlights
summary: Yum! Brands (NYSE:YUM) reported second-quarter growth across its operations excluding Pizza Hut, while management addressed a recent U.S. food-safety issue that has temporarily affected Taco Bell sales and outlined plans to sell Pizza Hut in separate transactions. Chief Executive Officer Chris Turn
